name: Cheesy Turkey Stuffed Poblanos (Baked)
ingredients_verbatim: 1 10 oz. can Green Chile Enchilada Sauce, gluten-free if needed
salt and fresh-ground black pepper to taste
2 T fresh or fresh-frozen lime juice
2 large Poblano Chiles + 1/2 cup chopped poblano pepper
why: Verified from the source's own nutrition card: 480 cal / 6.5g total carbs / 39g protein per serving - squarely mid-band and extremely low-carb (structurally meat + cheese + poblano + green-chile sauce, zero rice/pasta/potato/bean base). Excellent protein-to-calorie ratio. Straight oven bake at 375F, weigh-and-divide filling, scales cleanly to 14. Nearly everything maps to the board (ground-turkey, olive-oil, enchilada-sauce, garlic, limes, poblano-peppers, mozzarella->reduced-fat-mozzarella, green-onions); only ground cumin is a possible unmapped spice - a good light pricer-lane flag. DISTINCT: catalog/pool stuffed-pepper bakes all use BELL peppers (ground-turkey-stuffed-peppers-bake, ground-turkey-taco-stuffed-peppers) and the only turkey chile-relleno entry is a SKILLET - this is whole baked stuffed poblanos, a different dish.
